description: A well-specified feature request gets a spec on the first round, with no questions, that names the API field it asked for.

issue.title: Add due dates to todos
issue.body: Add an optional due date field to each todo item. The API should accept an ISO-8601 date string in the `dueDate` field when creating or updating a todo. The UI should show the due date next to each item and highlight overdue items in red. Items with no due date should display normally.
